note: The bands the Ugly Stik plant has to land in, from docs/UGLYSTIK-STAGE1.md, which derives each from RCM's published Das Ugly Stik (plan 939, May and June 1985: its data table, its travel limits and the full size plan, measured), O.S.'s figures for the 61FX, an owner's tachometer and APC's propeller data (scripts/uglystik-derive.js prints the derived figures). Set from the derivation before the plant was flown. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

u1_level_75.source: level speed at three quarter throttle, the trim RCM's pilot cranked in, derived 17.33; the band 15 percent either side, the Edge's

u2_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 9.48; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 0.95 / 4.824; the band the Edge's in proportion, 6 percent under and 14 over

u3_glide.source: L/D at 1.4 Vs, 13.27 m/s, derived 7.38; the band 11 percent either side, the Edge's

u4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 22.10, 10 percent either side

u5_climb.source: the best climb at a held airspeed, full throttle, derived 7.68 m/s at 12.0; 30 percent under and 20 over, the Kadet's in proportion. RCM: 'lots of straight up capability'

u6_roll.source: full aileron at RCM's travel limits (5/16 in up, 1/4 in down, on the 1.29 in strip aileron) from level flight at the trim, as the helix angle: Clda over -Clp times the mean throw, derived 0.0748 (95 deg/s at 17.3 m/s); 20 percent either side, the Edge's

u7_axial.source: a whole aileron roll from level at the trim, the elevator and the rudder centred, the pilot's hands off every other stick: the sideslip under 1.5 times the linear model's peak over the first quarter, 7.67 deg: the aircraft turns about its own axis rather than yawing off it (the bellcranks' differential). The nose's ground heading is printed and not held: its first band, 15 deg, was set with no reference behind it, and hands off the path dives 36 m through the roll, so a steep nose's ground projection swings and the number read the dive, not the axis (docs/UGLYSTIK-STAGE1.md)

u8_inverted.source: a section within a percent of symmetric at half a degree of incidence: on its back at three quarter throttle it flies within 5 percent of its upright speed, stalls within 6 percent of its upright stall speed and rolls within 5 percent of its upright rate, the Edge's bands; and holds level with a push, derived 5.0 deg of down elevator, 0.50 of the stick through the expo on RCM's 3/8 in of travel, 30 percent either side

u9_loop.source: half up stick held at full throttle from level at the full throttle speed, the ailerons and the rudder centred, on the plant's longitudinal equations integrated whole (scripts/uglystik-derive.js loopWhole): 41.35 m up and 32.56 m along, 13.55 m/s over the top, and out 4.52 m under its entry, 11 percent of its height; the plant's within 15 percent of each, out within 3 m of the derived exit, and straight: the heading within 15 deg and the wings within 15 deg of level over the top and out of it. The first bands were a point mass's that trims its angle of attack at once (44.6 m, 32.6 m, 13.3 m/s, out 0.9 m under): the plant came out 4.6 m under, outside the exit's band, and the whole equations, the short period's lag included, account for it to 0.1 m (docs/UGLYSTIK-STAGE1.md)

u10_neutral.source: from level at the trim rolled to 30 deg, every stick let go: the lateral model's spiral root is -0.015, a half life of 46 s, so it holds its bank, 26.6 deg after 6 s; the band the Kadet's in proportion. RCM: 'it goes where you point it until you tell it differently, no hands off inherent stability like a J-3 Cub'

u11_stall_power_off.source: full up held from level at 1.2 Vs with the throttle closed, the ailerons and rudder centred: a straight, untwisted wing whose thick section stalls from the trailing edge drops its nose and no wing, the Kadet's S9 bands

u11_stall_power_on.source: the same at half throttle with the wings held on the ailerons, as a pilot does: no roll rate past 20 deg/s, a wing drop's signature (the P-51's is 20 deg/s, docs/P51-STAGE1.md), and under half the aileron on average to hold them. Its first form, hands off the ailerons, read 22.6 deg of bank after 10 s: the prop's 0.21 N m rolling the stalled aircraft left at 2 deg/s, a slow torque roll with no break, recorded in docs/UGLYSTIK-STAGE1.md

u12_prop_torque.source: static full throttle, rolling left: APC's 0.612 N m for the 12 x 6 at 10,895 rpm, the engine's own torque, 15 percent either side

u13_phugoid.source: the phugoid at the trim on the linear longitudinal model, derived 14.91 s; 18 percent either side, the Kadet's

u14_rest.source: the drawn model at rest, idling: the plan's mains reach 0.31 in lower than its nose wheel, 1.48 deg nose down with the CG 0.2025 m up, and the idle's thrust held by the wheels leans it onto the nose wheel, derived -1.86 deg and 13.2 percent on the nose

u15_takeoff.source: full throttle from standing on grass, the heading held on the rudder and the nose wheel, rotated at 1.2 Vs to 8 deg: derived rolls to 1.1 and 1.5 Vs, 6.3 m at 10.4 m/s and 14.8 m at 14.2

u16_landing.source: a glide at idle, a flare, and on the wheels the elevator let go: at rest on three wheels within 1.5 deg of U14, no hull or prop

u17_unmoved.source: the five inch's canonical replay hash and every other aircraft's recorded flight hash in Node, from main's module at 71c0cbc, before the Ugly Stik existed

u18_cross_host.source: the Stik's recorded take off, roll, inverted run and loop, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome

u19_idle.source: the engine at O.S.'s 2,000 rpm idle keeps turning and its 1.22 N is under the 2.14 N the grass holds the aircraft with: it stands; the ground speed the Kadet's S20 band

u21_taxi.source: full right rudder at a walk: the wheelbase over tan of the nose wheel's 0.6 of the rudder's 14.6 deg, 0.300 / tan 8.78 deg, derived 1.94 m; 23 percent under and 29 over, the Edge's taxi band in proportion
